pages.title: Explore with care
pages.text: Beyond the Warper lie marble landscapes, forests, oceans, rough hills, floating terrain and sprawling city districts under a purple sky.$(br2)Bring blocks for awkward crossings and keep track of your route. The largest skyline is not always the safest first stop.

pages.title: Different places to explore
pages.text: Explore street districts, underground installations and floating ship-shaped complexes.$(br2)Self-contained complexes have organized defenses, security systems and AI Cores. Underground stations and beam tunnels connect parts of the landscape.$(br2)Scout an escape route before entering.
